title: game of life
how: ffmpeg's life source, in C, steps a 180×180 bool grid 15 times a second: n = conv2d(grid, ones(3,3)) − grid; grid = (n == 3) | (grid & (n == 2)).

title: rule 90
how: ffmpeg's cellauto source, in C, makes a new 270-bit row 15 times a second: row = roll(row, 1) ^ roll(row, −1), stacking the rows into a scrolling image.

title: rule 110
how: ffmpeg's cellauto source, in C, makes a new 270-bit row 30 times a second: k = 4·left + 2·self + right; row = (110 >> k) & 1, stacking the rows into a scrolling image.

title: mandelbrot
how: ffmpeg's mandelbrot source, in C, iterates z = z² + c up to 7,189 times for each of 720×720 pixels, colours each by its smooth escape count, and zooms the window every frame.
